name: Telegram
summary: Talk to Alexia from Telegram. Every message crosses Telegram's servers.

requires.why: To hold a connection open to Telegram and collect the messages you send it.
To hold a voice note or a file you sent for a moment while it is turned into words, then drop it.
To turn a reply into an Ogg/Opus voice note when you chose voice replies.

settings.label: Bot token
settings.hint: From @BotFather on Telegram. Send it /newbot and it hands you one. It is kept in this computer's keychain.

settings.label: Answer with a voice note
settings.hint: Voice replies need a cloned voice, chosen in the Voice plugin. Without one, every reply is text.

options.label: Never
options.hint: Every reply is text, even to a voice note.

options.label: When you send a voice note
options.hint: The reply comes back in the form the question went out in: speak and she speaks, type and she types.

options.label: Always
options.hint: Every reply is a voice bubble, including the answer to something you typed.

settings.label: Send what is due each morning at
settings.hint: A time in 24-hour form, in this machine's own clock. Leave it empty for no summary. It needs a plugin that keeps track of what you owe — without one there is nothing to list, so no summary goes out.

settings.label: Panel page address
settings.hint: The page the ⚙ Panel button opens in Telegram. Leave it as it is unless you host your own copy.

settings.label: Backup alerts if Telegram is down (ntfy topic)
settings.hint: Alerts go to this ntfy topic while Telegram is down. Anyone who knows the topic can read them. Leave it empty to send nothing.

settings.label: Pairing code
settings.hint: Send this code to your bot from the Telegram account you want to allow. Nobody else is answered.

settings.label: Forget who is allowed
settings.hint: Clears the allowed accounts and makes a new pairing code. Do this if the old one got out.

settings.label: Try again
settings.hint: Connects to Telegram again now. Use it after you quit another copy of Alexia that was using this bot.

commands.name: paired
commands.summary: Who is allowed to reach Alexia from Telegram
